## Before submitting

**Do not include API keys, API secrets, account credentials, private account details, recovery material, or sensitive screenshots.**

Public Issues are for user-facing ideas and feedback. Security vulnerabilities, private deployment details, credentials, and internal operational investigations should not be posted publicly.

## Problem / opportunity

What would you like GCC to make easier or better?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-facing result you would like to see.

## Why it is useful

Who would benefit and how?

## Additional context

Include only information that is safe to publish publicly.
